profileName: Enterprise Finance Landscape and View Policy

cases.input: L-STAT uses EUR, L-MGMT uses USD and presentation currency is GBP with a pinned rate set.
cases.expect: Source amounts remain intact and transformed rows cite book, basis, rate and rule versions.

cases.input: A plan and actual use different books but a pinned authorized mapping and responsibility scope.
cases.expect: The comparison is marked bridged and retains the transformation provenance.

cases.input: Both legs of an intercompany sale match with a small FX residual.
cases.expect: The consolidation book records the elimination and exposes the residual.

cases.input: One cost pool cannot be allocated under the pinned run.
cases.expect: The unallocated amount remains visible with reason and share.

cases.input: EUR and USD totals are combined into GBP without an authorized rate set.
cases.expect: The combined total is blocked and per-book subtotals plus missing pins are returned.

cases.input: An unmatched intercompany leg is silently eliminated.
cases.expect: The entry is rejected and reported as a visible break.

cases.input: A presentation suppresses unmatched and unallocated residuals from its total.
The same governed profile and complete pin set are executed twice.
cases.expect: The same immutable projection identity and digest are reproduced.

cases.input: The FX method changes in a successor Finance View Policy revision.
cases.expect: A new projection is issued and the prior projection remains immutable.

cases.input: A WM-ORG-012 unit is used directly as a Responsibility Centre.
cases.expect: Generation fails until an effective Responsibility Centre binding is pinned.

cases.input: Plan and actual amounts are merged as postings in one book.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected and the scenario-bound streams remain distinct.

cases.input: The landscape recomputes an elimination instead of citing the consolidation run output.
cases.expect: Issue fails because the landscape would become a shadow master.

cases.input: A result row cites a ledger revision not in the policy pin set.
Allocation conservation is tested after GBP translation.
cases.expect: The test is rejected and conservation is evaluated in source currency.

cases.input: The profile attempts to issue a governed elimination before Consolidation Scope, Run and Match are allocated.
cases.expect: The path remains rehearsal-only and no governed result is issued.

cases.input: Pinned plan and actual rows are paired while Metric Definition is unavailable.
cases.expect: A raw difference may be shown but it is not labelled a governed variance metric.

cases.input: Profile registration is used as authority to disclose a combined total.
